Game Overview

In Doodle Run 3D, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a whimsical doodle universe where each run is a fresh adventure. Simple tap-and-swipe controls let you jump or slide through quirky, endless obstacles. Master this addictive odyssey by balancing speed with caution, and aim to top the global leaderboard one doodle dash at a time.
